svg.title: AI Evolution Map Since AlexNet
svg.desc: Detailed English SVG showing major milestones and evolution paths in AI from 2012 to 2026 across vision, language models, generation, reinforcement learning, multimodal systems, and agentic reasoning.
svg.text: Dense reference SVG for milestone nodes and evolution paths, with the 2023-2026 large-model explosion shown in higher detail.
1. Frontier closed models and strong open models advanced at the same time.
2. Long context, coding, and multimodality became core model axes.
3. Reasoning moved from prompting tricks to test-time compute and RL-trained model families.
4. Tool use and agents shifted the goal from answering questions to finishing work.
Cross-lane transfer of ideas or capability
Read left to right as a timeline. Read top to bottom as interacting tracks that repeatedly merge:
deep vision -> transformers -> scaling -> alignment -> multimodality -> reasoning -> tools -> agentic workflows.
